# Windsurf / Devin Desktop

Add to `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json` (Windsurf) or `~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json` (Devin Desktop):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gupshup": {
      "serverUrl": "https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

No Gupshup Enterprise account yet? Email [sales@gupshup.ai](mailto:sales@gupshup.ai).

Something not working? See [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md).
